# Dorza

> Dorza is a Western Sydney-based AI-native digital agency that provides done-for-you websites, social media management, Google Business setup, local SEO, and AI marketing agents for small businesses. Based in Parramatta, serving all of Western Sydney. Pricing starts from $199/month with no lock-in contracts.

## What Dorza offers

- **Custom websites** — hand-coded, mobile-first, SEO-ready websites built around the client's brand. Not templates.
- **Social media management** — automated, on-brand posting to Instagram and Facebook using AI-generated content calendars (3–5 posts/week depending on plan).
- **Google Business Profile setup** — profile creation, optimisation, and ongoing management for local search visibility in Google Maps.
- **Local SEO** — on-page optimisation, local citation building, review strategy, and suburb-targeted content for ranking in local search.
- **AI agents** — on-demand marketing assistants for content creation, campaign management, and customer enquiry handling.
- **Research and strategy** — competitor analysis and market opportunity mapping for local Sydney businesses.

## Pricing

| Plan | Monthly | Setup fee | Includes |
|------|---------|-----------|----------|
| Starter | $199/mo | $499 | Website + Google Business |
| Growth | $349/mo | $799 | Website + Social (3x/week) + AI chatbot + Review management |
| Pro | $549/mo | $1,299 | Everything in Growth + Paid ads + 5 posts/week + Strategy call |

No lock-in contracts. Cancel any time. Founding client offer: 50% off setup for the first 20 Sydney clients.

## Who Dorza is for

Sydney small businesses including cafes, restaurants, tradies, salons, beauty businesses, gyms, fitness studios, retail shops, and professional services providers who want a full digital presence without hiring an in-house team or paying traditional agency rates.

## Why Dorza vs a traditional agency

Traditional agencies in Sydney typically charge $3,000+/month on 12-month lock-in retainers. Dorza delivers the same outcome — website, social, search visibility — for around 85% less, month-to-month, with a single team and fast iteration.

## Service areas

Dorza is based in Parramatta and serves small businesses across Western Sydney, including:
- Parramatta (2150) — Sydney's second CBD, growing fast with the new Metro and Powerhouse
- Blacktown (2148) — Sydney's most populated LGA with 400,000+ residents
- Penrith (2750) — gateway to the Blue Mountains, booming with Western Sydney Airport nearby
- Liverpool (2170) — South-Western Sydney commercial hub with one of Sydney's youngest populations
- Campbelltown (2560) — one of Sydney's fastest-growing corridors, population doubling by 2036
- Castle Hill (2154) — Hills District hub

## Industries we specialise in

- **Cafes & restaurants** — mobile-first menus, booking integration (OpenTable, Quandoo, ResDiary), Instagram management, Google Business for walk-in traffic
- **Tradies** — lead generation websites, Google Business dominance, before/after work portfolios, service area SEO, click-to-call forms
- **Salons & beauty** — portfolio websites with image galleries, online booking integration (Fresha, Timely, Square), Instagram content strategy, review management
